name: Усунення захисника: зв’язка (3)
description:
This lesson once again brings the concept of a deflection into play. In Example 1, a defender is lured away from an important square. In Example 2, we deflect a pawn, with opens an important file. We can then material with a pin.

What do you have to do?

Deflect a defender and then win material with a pin.

examples.text: 1.Bh4 does not work yet because of 1...Txh4. So white must first deflect the rook away: 1.Rxg8! and if black takes back with 1...Rxg8, white pins the queen: 2.Bh4.

The black queen and king are on the same line (here: file). However, there is another pawn between them. With that pawn eliminated, white can pin the queen with Rc2. With a double attack white forces black to open the c-file: 1.Nd5+! (attacks the queen and king) 1...cxd5 (the c-pawn is lured away) 2.Rc2 and the queen is pinned!

texts: Try to deny Black a defensive option so that a pin is winning.
